title: Input buffer windows: Arisen vs played pawns (DPC 0.9.177-dev6)
intro: Runs by itself on the test bench. Light-attack taps on the Arisen, then on two played pawns; records which buffer and input-window flags the game's track sets for each.

probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.who: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; return s and s.active and tostring(s.pawn_name) or 'Arisen'
probes.a_buf: local ok, r = pcall(function() local t = H.arisen():call('get_Human'):get_field('Track'); if not t then return '' end; local o = {}; for _, n in ipairs({'NormalAttackBuffer','SkillBuffer','ComboAttackBuffer','CatchBuffer','JumpBuffer','EvasionBuffer','CancelBuffer','SpecialCancelBuffer','AllBuffer'}) do if t:get_field(n) then o[#o+1] = n end end; return table.concat(o, ' ') end); return ok and r or 'err'
probes.a_now: local ok, r = pcall(function() local t = H.arisen():call('get_Human'):get_field('Track'); if not t then return '' end; local o = {}; for _, n in ipairs({'NormalAttack','Skill','ComboAttack','Jump','Evasion','Cancel','All'}) do if t:get_field(n) then o[#o+1] = n end end; return table.concat(o, ' ') end); return ok and r or 'err'
probes.p_buf: local ok, r = pcall(function() local t = (function() local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; return s and s.active and s.pawn_chara end)():call('get_Human'):get_field('Track'); if not t then return '' end; local o = {}; for _, n in ipairs({'NormalAttackBuffer','SkillBuffer','ComboAttackBuffer','CatchBuffer','JumpBuffer','EvasionBuffer','CancelBuffer','SpecialCancelBuffer','AllBuffer'}) do if t:get_field(n) then o[#o+1] = n end end; return table.concat(o, ' ') end); return ok and r or 'err'
probes.p_now: local ok, r = pcall(function() local t = (function() local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; return s and s.active and s.pawn_chara end)():call('get_Human'):get_field('Track'); if not t then return '' end; local o = {}; for _, n in ipairs({'NormalAttack','Skill','ComboAttack','Jump','Evasion','Cancel','All'}) do if t:get_field(n) then o[#o+1] = n end end; return table.concat(o, ' ') end); return ok and r or 'err'
probes.p_n0: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; return s and s.active and H.node(s.pawn_chara) or ''
